title: These MacBook refurbs are under $200
content:
Macworld

TL;DR: This refurbished Apple MacBook Pro is on sale for $199.97 (reg. $699).

Brand-new MacBooks have always been pretty expensive, but it’s even harder to deal with when tech prices are rising across the board. If you want a good computer for the basics, older refurbished tech is a great option. This MacBook Pro refurb has a Grade B rating, meaning it only shows minor signs of wear, but it still works great, and you can pick it up on sale for just $199.97 (reg. $699).

This MacBook has a 2.3GHz dual-core Intel Core i5 processor, enough to handle a full spread of browser tabs and everyday apps without stalling. The 13.3-inch Retina display pushes 2560 by 1600 pixels, so photos and video look sharp, and colors come through crisp and vibrant. Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 keeps video streaming and light gaming smooth.

In 2026, 8GB of RAM is still pretty solid, and this MacBook also has a 128GB SSD for apps and files. On a full charge, the battery lasts up to 10 hours, so a workday away from an outlet stays doable. macOS support goes all the way up to Ventura, so current apps and security updates still install. This unit has a grade B rating, meaning light scuffing or minor scratches on the case that don’t affect how it runs.

Get a dependable Mac without paying full retail price.

Right now, this MacBook Pro refurb is on sale for just $199.97.
